patch_description: Crossover of the random-restart local search (program 3) with the symmetric ring-seed layout (program 1). Key improvements: (1) warm-start the search with the structured ring layout (center + two staggered 5-point rings) in addition to uniform random barycentric starts, which lands the optimizer directly in a good basin; (2) keep the fully-vectorized batched candidate evaluation (_min_area_batch) so each iteration tests K perturbations at once; (3) keep the fast barycentric projection for feasibility; (4) focus perturbations on points from the few worst triplets while allowing occasional all-point moves to escape local optima; (5) an annealed step schedule with geometric decay. Deterministic via fixed seeds, with a safe fallback returning the projected ring layout on any failure.
